name: USGS SIM 3327 interpreted offshore geology, San Simeon

temporal.update_cadence: Static map publication; monthly source change check

provenance.access_service: Original USGS Scientific Investigations Map 3327 download
transformations: Project original WGS84 UTM 10 polygon geometry into native CSUMB NAD83 UTM 10 screen
Inset interpreted pure-bedrock polygons by 10 m for research-only overlap

evidence.supports: Primary USGS publication describes interpreted offshore geology using integrated multibeam, backscatter, samples where available, magnetic and seismic data.
Original 753,951-byte ZIP opened and SHA-256 pinned; 625 polygons have MapUnitAbb and UnitType attributes in WGS84 UTM zone 10.
USGS metadata distinguishes exposed bedrock from thin, potentially ephemeral sediment over bedrock and notes that lithology may be inferred where samples are unavailable.

limitations: Interpreted geology is not a direct rock sample at every polygon cell, a boulder inventory or evidence of current fish abundance.
Composite Qms/bedrock units are excluded from the exposed-bedrock overlap because sediment can cover the older rock.
The research overlap with CSUMB roughness uses related bathymetry evidence; it is not an independent confirmation of every rough cell.
The separate CSUMB depth grid uses NAVD88 Geoid09; these geology polygons alone do not certify MLLW depth, legal access or a fishing waypoint.
